Dr. Mara Lind

Group leader, Spatial Atlas Group

Research

Mara Lind studies how immune cells settle in the human lung. Her group maps lung tissue at single-cell resolution and builds open reference atlases.

Methods

  • spatial transcriptomics
  • single-cell RNA sequencing

Career

Since 2023: group leader at the Institute of Open Atlases.
2018 - 2023: postdoctoral researcher in Uppsala.
